stories.title: Pentagon says execution of Fort Hood shooter will be livestreamed

en.title: Pentagon says execution of Fort Hood shooter will be livestreamed
en.summary: The Pentagon confirmed that the execution of former army psychiatrist Nidal Hasan, who killed 13 people at Fort Hood, will be livestreamed publicly on December 3rd, marking the first US military execution in over six decades.

en.title: NHS at risk of 'system failures' as demand for ADHD and autism care soars, inquiry finds
en.summary: A government-commissioned review warns England's NHS faces potential system failures due to surging demand for mental health, ADHD, and autism services. The inquiry found people needing support are experiencing severe delays and difficulties accessing care.

en.summary: A major review concludes that not all individuals displaying ADHD and autism traits require formal diagnosis, while calling for comprehensive system reform to better serve those most in need.
